stories.headline: Old Mill Grocery & Deli closes in Westport as Ricci brothers prep Darien restaurant
stories.summary: Graziano and Maurizio Ricci closed Old Mill Grocery & Deli on Hillspoint Road near Compo Beach this week after three years, Patch reported Sept. 30, as the brothers prepare a new Italian restaurant at Heights Crossing in Darien this fall. Their Railroad Place restaurant in Westport remains open. The Soundview Empowerment Alliance, which owns the 107-year-old property, said it is in talks with prospective operators to keep a grocery at the site.

stories.headline: White House touts 96% drop in legal immigration from Muslim-majority nations
stories.summary: A White House X post highlighting Cato Institute data showing roughly a 96% cut in legal immigration from Muslim-majority countries since 2024 drew cheers from Republicans on Sept. 30. The chart shows monthly admissions that once topped 22,000 falling toward near zero after Trump took office in January 2025. GOP lawmakers and Turning Point figures framed the drop as a midterm-worthy win, while Cato’s David Bier said the policy harms Americans — though courts have not ruled the reduction illegal.

stories.headline: State Department says it has revoked more than 250,000 visas under Trump
stories.summary: The State Department told Fox News Digital it has revoked more than 250,000 visas since Trump returned to office, citing crimes, fraud, birth tourism, terrorism support, and national-security threats. Spokesperson Tommy Pigott called the milestone historic continuous vetting; about 2,300 revocations tied to birth tourism. The agency also yanked visas for 27 Latin American officials over corruption allegations this week, and officials have floated broader B1/B2 cuts for asylum claimants.

stories.headline: Trump announces $54 billion South Korean investment in Alaska natural-gas pipeline
stories.summary: President Trump said Wednesday South Korea will invest about $54 billion to export Alaska natural gas via an 807-mile North Slope-to-LNG pipeline long pushed by Sen. Dan Sullivan, who faces a tough reelection fight. The pledge ties to a 2025 trade deal that swapped lower auto tariffs for hundreds of billions in U.S. investment. Officials said pipeline construction could take three years with exports two years later if financing lands — part of a midterm push showcasing foreign-investment wins in contested red states.

stories.headline: Navarro warns Canada will ‘pay even more dearly’ if it ‘interferes’ in U.S. midterms
stories.summary: Trump trade adviser Peter Navarro told a Washington economic conference Tuesday that Canadian lobbyists should “get the hell out” of the U.S. and that Ottawa would “pay even more dearly” if it interfered in races in Maine or Michigan. He did not detail what interference would look like as new U.S. bans on some Canadian alcohol, dairy byproducts, motorcycles, and molasses took effect. Trump said he expects Canada to return to talks within weeks seeking tariff relief.

stories.headline: GW student groups slam Turning Point ‘Infidels’ screening as Islamophobic
stories.summary: At least 11 George Washington University student organizations, including SJP, MSA, and the SGA, condemned TPUSA’s Monday campus screening of Daily Wire’s “Run Hide Fight: Infidels,” calling the film Islamophobic. Chapter president Ryan Van Slingerland said the backlash proves First Amendment culture has atrophied. The film follows students fighting a radical Islamist takeover of a campus distracted by a pro-Palestinian encampment; SGA passed a nonbinding resolution opposing future funding for similar events.

stories.headline: Apple’s smart home hub rumored with iMac G4-style design for Oct. 13 unveil
stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says Apple’s long-rumored smart home hub will use a square 6-inch display on a rounded metal base recalling the 2002 iMac G4, plus a wall-mount J491 variant, MacRumors reported Sept. 30. The always-plugged USB-C device will handle HomeKit, FaceTime, intercom, recipes, and face/voice personalization with visitor privacy mode. Interface mixes Watch, TV, and iPad cues with StandBy-style clocks; introduction is expected Oct. 13 beside new HomePod mini and Apple TV models.

stories.headline: SpaceXAI weighs four-tier Grok and X pricing from free to $100 Ultra
stories.summary: Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI is evaluating a unified four-tier subscription for Grok and X, Bloomberg reported via an internal document summarized Sept. 30. Plans reportedly stretch from a capped free tier to a $100 monthly Ultra package that includes Grok Bot agent access, plus an $8 Lite bundle pairing Grok with an X verified badge and lighter ads. The move aims to broaden adoption and monetize heavy compute as SpaceXAI competes with OpenAI and Anthropic.

stories.headline: Jets’ Aaron Glenn preps for Bears’ Ben Johnson — familiar foes from Lions days
stories.summary: Jets coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday his club is ready for Sunday’s Week 4 rematch with Chicago and former Lions colleague Ben Johnson, who coordinated Detroit’s offense while Glenn ran the defense. The Bears (2-1) crushed Philadelphia 27–7 on MNF behind Case Keenum with Caleb Williams still nursing a hamstring; the Jets (1–2) just lost to Detroit 31–24. Both teams rank among the NFL’s top clock-control offenses, setting up a Soldier Field battle of sustained drives.

stories.headline: Oakbrook Center mall shooting leaves man dead, woman wounded; three in custody
stories.summary: Oak Brook police say a man was killed and a woman wounded shortly after noon Wednesday in the Oakbrook Center parking lot outside L.L.Bean after an altercation between two vehicles carrying five people turned into an exchange of gunfire. One vehicle fled and was found in Oakbrook Terrace; three occupants were taken into custody. Police have not named the victim, disclosed a motive, or announced charges; an update is expected Thursday. The mall stayed open amid a heavy police presence.

stories.headline: LEGO Pick a Brick Q4 preview: dragon knights, seal, and Classic Space astronaut
stories.summary: Stonewars previewed upcoming LEGO Pick a Brick parts shown at Skærbæk, with Q4 2026 drops spanning animals, minifigs, and prints. Highlights include a Medium Brown seal in October, Sea Serpent GWP dragon-knight torso and shield in November, a light-blue Classic Space astronaut completion pack, and Creator pirate figs available as soon as Oct. 1. Printed Hubble tiles, Architecture windows, and new plant colors round out the appetizer ahead of monthly PaB lists.

stories.headline: Harley-Davidson revives Super Glide for 2026: Softail, 117 Classic, 2,500 units
stories.summary: Harley revived the Super Glide name for 2026 on a modern Softail chassis with the Milwaukee-Eight 117 Classic (98 hp, 120 lb-ft), mini-apes, mid controls, a five-gallon tank, White Onyx Pearl paint, and chrome laced wheels, TopSpeed reported Sept. 30. Production is capped at 2,500 serialized bikes worldwide at a $15,999 U.S. MSRP — about $1,000 over the related Street Bob — packing Road/Sport/Rain modes, cornering ABS, traction control, and TPMS under throwback FX-inspired styling.
